Container.Name: flextrainer
Container.Overview: Self-hosted exam trainer. Upload PDF, Word or Markdown files (or scrape web pages) to turn them into practice exams, track your progress, resume where you left off and let ChatGPT check every question with a short explanation and a suggested reference link. All data lives in a SQLite database on your own server. First login after the first start: admin / admin (you must change it immediately).

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface (always 8000 inside the container).

Config.Name: Data (database, backups, logs)
Config.Description: SQLite database, weekly backups, logs and the session secret. Keep this on the array/cache so updates never cost data.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default 100 = users).

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: ChatGPT API key for question checks. You can also enter it in the app under Settings.

Config.Name: OPENAI_MODEL
Config.Description: Optional: ChatGPT model used for checks.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_THEME
Config.Description: Optional: theme for the first account (daylight, sand, midnight, nord, forest).

Config.Name: BACKUP_ENABLED
Config.Description: Optional: automatic weekly backups on/off (true/false). Empty = on.

Config.Name: BACKUP_KEEP
Config.Description: Optional: number of backups to keep. Empty = 7.

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: Optional: sub-path when served behind a reverse proxy, e.g. /flextrainer.

Config.Name: ALLOW_PRIVATE_SCRAPE
Config.Description: Optional: true lets the scraper fetch LAN/private addresses. Off by default.
